name: Teaching And Preaching
overview: Scripture reveals that teaching and preaching are vital for guiding believers in truth and righteousness, as the Word serves as a lamp to illuminate our path (Psalms 119:105). Jesus commissioned His followers to proclaim the gospel to all people (Mark 16:15), demonstrating the central role of preaching in spreading salvation. The Word made flesh embodies grace and truth, providing the foundation for faithful teaching (John 1:14). However, James warns that those who teach bear greater responsibility and judgment (James 3:1), underscoring the need for purity and peace in the fruit of righteous instruction (James 3:18).
